head: Android Earthquake Alerts System now in Italy: how to get the alerts
dek: Google switched on Android's earthquake alerts in Italy on 19 November, so Android phones there can warn of nearby shaking a few seconds before it arrives.
details: Android phones work together to detect earthquakes; the system has run since 2021 and has sent more than a billion alerts. There are three levels: a simple alert for light shaking, a more detailed one telling you to get ready for stronger shaking, and a full-screen alert with steps to protect yourself for moderate to strong shaking. In the coming months the middle alert will add a map of the area, the estimated magnitude, what to do and a button for updates. Alerts are on by default, need Wi-Fi or mobile data and use your approximate location.
where: Italy, Android phones, on by default
means: If you live in or visit Italy with an Android phone, you may get a few seconds to take cover before the shaking reaches you.
todo: Check that it's on: Settings > Safety & emergency > Earthquake alerts (or Settings > Location > Advanced > Earthquake alerts), and keep Wi-Fi or mobile data switched on.
